one_liner: Transactional and marketing email delivery platform (Twilio) with a REST API for sending mail and managing contacts.

auth.evidence_quote: To authenticate, add an HTTP Authorization header to your API request that contains an API Key
auth.notes: Uses Bearer-style header 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>' but the vendor calls it an API Key. No OAuth2 documented for acting on other users' accounts (each customer supplies their own key), except via SendGrid's separate Partner/reseller subuser mechanisms.

access.evidence_quote: To authenticate, add an HTTP Authorization header to your API request that contains an API Key
access.notes: SendGrid offers a free-tier account with API key generation from the dashboard, no separate review gate documented for basic API key use.

api.evidence_quote: To authenticate, add an HTTP Authorization header to your API request that contains an API Key
api.notes: SendGrid v3 API covers mail send, marketing campaigns, stats, webhooks, etc. -- a broad surface; did not verify official MCP within call budget.

verdict.rationale: Free-tier account with self-service API key generation and no review gate for standard API key usage.
